claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Glipizide is a sulfonylurea that closes ATP-sensitive potassium channels in pancreatic beta cells; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines, with no plausible cytotoxic mechanism at this concentration.
